description: #54: the settings name TWO repositories in `[repos]` (`alder`, `birch`) and the ready task is the birch project's, so a dispatch that omits `--clone` has no default to use and one that guesses cuts the tree from the wrong repository. The coordinator passes the project's name as `--clone birch`, not a path and not the other name. The harness builds one clone, so only `birch-checkout` is a repository; `alder-checkout` is a plain directory the fixture carries as a placeholder, which means a wrong pick would fail on a missing repository as well as on the graders. The prompt asks for a dry-run worker launch so no worker process starts.
prompt: Start the birch security audit. For this isolated test, use --dry-run for the worker launch and do not start a real worker process.

graders.rule: The repository is a name from the settings' `[repos]` table, passed as `--clone <name>`; omit `--clone` when the table has one entry.
